P.text: A gauge is killed via GaugeManager.killGauge() and later revived via GaugeManager.reviveGauge(); neither function updates the gauge-specific supplyIndex[_gauge] checkpoint, so it remains frozen at the pre-kill value while the global index accumulator continues to grow with each notifyRewardAmount.
P.evidence_quote: When a gauge is killed, its `supplyIndex` remains frozen at the pre-kill value.

I.text: The per-gauge supplyIndex checkpoint should be synchronized with the global index on kill/revive so that reward calculation deltas do not span epochs when the gauge was inactive.
I.evidence_quote: Neither `killGauge()` nor `reviveGauge()` updates the per-gauge checkpoint that tracks reward distribution eligibility

V.text: Upon revival, _updateForAfterDistribution() computes rewards using the delta between the current index and the stale supplyIndex[_gauge], allowing the revived gauge to retroactively claim rewards that accrued during its inactive period.
V.evidence_quote: Upon revival, this stale checkpoint allows the gauge to retroactively claim all rewards that accrued during its inactive period through the [_updateForAfterDistribution()]... calculation.
